executiveSummary.description: Fixed 40 blockers (cr-dotnet-0010, cr-dotnet-0025, cr-dotnet-0013) by updating target framework, removing Web.config transforms, and wrapping SqlConnection with using blocks and EF Core using. 227 legacy .NET Framework blockers (CSS, Web Forms, session, CSP, JS) could not be fully remediated without major architecture rewrites; build not executed because project targets .NET Framework 4.5.2 on Linux image. Added safe logging config not needed (no new cloud SDK added).
